scope: Custom — Sunday, October 11, 2026 games with scheduled kickoff before 2:00 PM Eastern Time
historical_cutoff: 2026-10-06T00:00:00-04:00 — after completion of the final scheduled Week 4 game; no Week 5 games included

current_alternate_source.source_note: Latest available repository snapshot; not independently refreshed live during Stage 2.

methodology.alternate_hit_rule: L10 hits count locked observations strictly greater than the alternate numeric line, matching Over semantics for the sportsbook's numeric line.
methodology.floor: Lowest available alternate threshold with historical HR >=60%.
methodology.core: Highest available alternate threshold with historical HR >=60%.
methodology.ceiling: Next higher available threshold above Core regardless of HR; unavailable if none.
methodology.stage3_narrowing: Carry forward if Core HR >=70%, or Floor HR >=90%. This uses the model's minimum final-leg HR (70%) and Low-Variance preferred HR (90%) to preserve candidates with either a viable Core or a particularly strong Floor. This is candidate screening, not a prediction.
